results.title: Is the End Near? Medicare Telehealth Flexibilities Set to Expire at the End of the Year
results.snippet: A pending Congressional proposal, H.R. 7623 – Telehealth Modernization Act of 2024, would provide a partial fix by extending the expiration date by two years. While the measure was originally proposed to make the telehealth flexibilities permanent, the House Energy and Commerce Committee amended to only a two year extension citing cost considerations. H.R. 7623 is strongly supported by provider and patient advocacy groups but has not advanced out of committee. [1]

results.title: Medicare Telehealth Flexibilities: Countdown to September 30, 2025
results.snippet: In the final hours of 2024, Congress passed a six-month extension of the Medicare telehealth flexibilities through its 2025 funding bill , pushing the expiration date to September 30, 2025. Now, with that deadline quickly approaching, many telehealth providers are left wondering whether Congress will act in time.
